2608.24302.title: VideoHarness-RSI: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement for Long-Video Understanding with Frozen Vision-Language Models
2608.24302.paper_summary: Long-video understanding depends critically on how a limited model context is constructed from a much longer video. Existing approaches improve this process through compression, retrieval, memory, and agentic evidence acquisition, but these mechanisms are typically introduced as part of a manually designed inference system or optimized together with other components. This makes it difficult to isolate a simpler question: how much can be gained by improving the executable context-construction program alone? We study this question through VIDEOHARNESS-RSI, a controlled baseline for recursively searching executable context constructors around a frozen vision-language model (VLM). An outer-loop proposer uses prior programs, evaluation outcomes, and execution traces to generate candidate harnesses, which are executed and evaluated end to end before successful variants are retained for further search. This makes long-video understanding a controlled instance of automated harness design: the searchable object is executable program structure, while the answering model and interface remain fixed. Starting from uniform sampling, recursive harness search consistently finds room for improvement and surpasses several weaker hand-crafted baselines. Starting instead from a stronger hand-crafted baseline, the same RSI process yields a further improvement. The selected harness also transfers to additional long-video benchmarks without further search. Together, these results establish executable context construction as a distinct optimization layer and provide a reproducible baseline for studying harness discovery and transfer around frozen VLMs.
2608.24302.paper_summary_zh: 長視頻理解在很大程度上依賴於如何從更長的視頻中構建有限的模型上下文。現有的方法通過壓縮、檢索、記憶和主動證據獲取來改善這一過程，但這些機制通常作為手動設計推理系統的一部分引入，或與其他組件一起進行優化。這使得隔離一個更簡單的問題變得困難：僅通過改善可執行的上下文構建程序可以獲得多少收益？我們通過VIDEOHARNESS-RSI來研究這個問題，這是一個受控的基準，用於在凍結的視覺-語言模型（VLM）周圍遞歸搜索可執行上下文構建器。外部循環提議者使用先前的程序、評估結果和執行痕跡來生成候選工具，這些工具在執行和評估後會被保留成功變體以進行進一步搜索。這使得長視頻理解成為自動化工具設計的一個受控實例：可搜索的對象是可執行程序結構，而回答模型和界面保持不變。從均勻抽樣開始，遞歸工具搜索始終找到改進的空間，並超越幾個較弱的手工基準。相反，從一個較強的手工基準開始，相同的RSI過程會產生進一步的改進。所選擇的工具還可以在不進一步搜索的情況下轉移到其他長視頻基準。綜合這些結果，確立了可執行上下文構建作為一個獨特的優化層，並提供了一個可重複的基準，用於研究凍結的VLM周圍的工具發現和轉移。
